title_original: 대법원 윤리감사관과 그 보좌기관 및 분장사무에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Ethics Inspector General)
(1) Under the direction of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, the Ethics Inspector General shall take charge of court audit affairs (excluding "audits concerning judicial affairs, etc." under Article 5 of the Rules on the Processing of Judicial Affairs of Courts) and matters concerning official ethics of judges and court officials.
(2) The Ethics Inspector General shall be a political appointee, and remuneration shall be equal to that of a Vice Minister.
